name: procupine-vscode
description: The processes running on this machine, as a process explorer shows them: a live tree with CPU, memory, and I/O, each process's history, its details, and killing, suspending, and resuming. Windows, Linux, and macOS, and the remote machine of a remote window (SSH, WSL, containers).

procupine.path.description: The procupine program to run (empty: the one this extension carries).

procupine.interval.description: How often the processes are sampled, in milliseconds (the panel's own choice, once made, is kept with it).

procupine.confirmKill.description: Ask before killing or terminating processes.
